verse.unicode: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: khojat khojat khoj beechaario raam naam tat saaraa ||

en.bdb: I have searched and searched and searched, and found that the Lord's Name is the most sublime reality.

verse.unicode: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: kilabikh kaaTe nimakh araadhiaa gurmukh paar utaaraa ||1||

en.bdb: Contemplating it for even an instant, sins are erased; the Gurmukh is carried across and saved. ||1||
Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, O man of spiritual wisdom.

verse.unicode: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: sun sun mahaa tirapat man paavai saadhoo a(n)mirat baanee || rahaau ||

en.bdb: Listening to the Ambrosial Words of the Holy Saints, the mind finds absolute fulfillment and satisfaction. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: mukat bhugat jugat sach paieeaai sarab sukhaa kaa dhaataa ||

en.bdb: Liberation, pleasures, and the true way of life are obtained from the Lord, the Giver of all peace.

verse.unicode: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: apune dhaas kau bhagat dhaan dhevai pooran purakh bidhaataa ||2||

en.bdb: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, blesses His slave with the gift of devotional worship. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਰਸਨਾ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: sravanee suneeaai rasanaa gaieeaai hiradhai dhiaaieeaai soiee ||

en.bdb: Hear with your ears, and sing with your tongue, and meditate within your heart on Him.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: karan kaaran samarath suaamee jaa te birathaa na koiee ||3||

en.bdb: The Lord and Master is all-powerful, the Cause of causes; without Him, there is nothing at all. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥

transliteration.english: vaddai bhaag ratan janam paiaa karahu kirapaa kirapaalaa ||

en.bdb: By great good fortune, I have obtained the jewel of human life; have mercy on me, O Merciful Lord.

verse.unicode: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥

transliteration.english: saadhasa(n)g naanak gun gaavai simarai sadhaa guopaalaa ||4||10||

en.bdb: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and contemplates Him forever in meditation. ||4||10||
